Rearranged Paragraph: On May 30, Agnikul Cosmos successfully conducted the first test flight of its rocket ‘Agnibaan’ in the ‘Suborbital Tech Demonstrator’ (SOrTeD) mission, marking a pivotal step for India’s commercial launch services. This two-stage, semi-cryogenic rocket, designed for small satellite deployment, had many 3D-printed components and was partly scaled back for the test. Agnikul's success, following four aborted attempts, mirrors Skyroot’s 2022 ‘Vikram’ launch, showcasing the synergy between ISRO and private startups. These startups benefit from ISRO’s mentorship while fostering innovation that could inform ISRO’s projects, like the semi-cryogenic engine. India must streamline bureaucratic and legal frameworks to sustain this collaborative knowledge flow, anticipated to fuel advancements across various fields beyond aerospace.

questions.text: Which of the following should be the SECOND sentence after rearrangement?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'C.'

Key Points

  • The correct sequence or order of the segments after rearrangement is DCBEA.
    • The sentence 'D' is independent of any other sentence as it introduces the topic of ''An online charity chess match between Kamath and Anand'' to raise funds for those suffering due to the coronavirus pandemic.
    • Sentence C will come after D as it gives further information about the event in which Kamath cheated against Anand by using the assistance of chess analysts and engines.
    • Sentence B will come after C, as it says Kamath later apologized for the cheating, considering it 'quite silly'.
    • Sentence E will come after B, as it says due to such an incident, Chess.com, the virtual platform that was used to play the charity game, decided to ban Kamath's account.
    • The sentence 'A' concludes by saying that Chess.com later restored Kamath's account within 24 hours.


Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences: Kamath participated in an online charity chess match against Viswanathan Anand to raise funds for those suffering due to the coronavirus pandemic. During the event, Kamath cheated against Anand by using the assistance of chess analysts and engines. Kamath later apologized, calling his behaviour 'quite silly'. Following the match, Chess.com, the virtual platform that was used to play the charity game, decided to ban his account. However, Chess.com restored his account within 24 hours.

Additional Information

  • Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles:
    • Read the sentences attentively, try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence, and eliminate the irrelevant options.
    • Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
    • Try to identify the mandatory pairs; two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.
